---
title: "Weekly Bet Cheat Sheet"
output: html_document
params:
  bet_table: null
  survivor_teams: null
  bet_details: null
  team_lookup_table: null
  season: null
  week: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(httr)
library(rvest)
library(htmltools)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(nflreadr)
source('app_helper_funs.R')

```


```{r}
bettors = unique(params$bet_table$Bettor)
placed_bets = params$bet_table %>%
  inner_join(params$bet_details %>% select(bet_display_name, depth_rank, jersey_number, position) %>% distinct(), join_by('Label' == 'bet_display_name'))

placed_bets = placed_bets %>% mutate(Team = ifelse(Team == 'LA', 'LAR', Team), Opp = ifelse(Opp == 'LA','LAR',Opp)) %>%
  filter(Gametime >= Sys.time() - 120*60) %>%
  left_join(params$team_lookup_table %>% select(FullName, TV_abbr) %>% rename('TeamFullName' = 'FullName'), join_by('Team' == 'TV_abbr')) %>%
  left_join(params$team_lookup_table %>% select(FullName, TV_abbr) %>% rename('OppFullName' = 'FullName'), join_by('Opp' == 'TV_abbr')) %>%
  mutate(game = paste(pmin(TeamFullName, OppFullName), pmax(TeamFullName, OppFullName), sep = " - "))
      
games = load_schedules(params$season) %>% clean_homeaway() %>% filter(week == params$week) %>%
  mutate(team = ifelse(team == 'LA', 'LAR', team),
         opponent = ifelse(opponent == 'LA','LAR',opponent)) %>%
  mutate(posix_timestamp_game = as.POSIXct(paste(gameday, gametime), tz = "America/New_York")) %>%
  mutate(time_parsed = parse_date_time(gametime, orders = c("I:Mp","I:M p","H:M")),
         Timeslot = paste(weekday, case_when(hour(time_parsed) < 11 ~ 'Morning',
                                         hour(time_parsed) < 15 ~ 'Early Window',
                                         hour(time_parsed) < 19 ~ 'Late Window',
                                         TRUE ~ 'Night'))) %>%
  left_join(params$team_lookup_table %>% select(FullName, TV_abbr) %>% rename('TeamFullName' = 'FullName'), join_by('team' == 'TV_abbr')) %>%
  left_join(params$team_lookup_table %>% select(FullName, TV_abbr) %>%
              rename('OppFullName' = 'FullName'), join_by('opponent' == 'TV_abbr')) %>%
  mutate(game = paste(pmin(TeamFullName, OppFullName),
                      pmax(TeamFullName, OppFullName),
                      sep = " - ")) %>%
  arrange(TeamFullName)

if(length(params$survivor_teams) > 0)
{
  survivor_team_df = params$survivor_teams %>% data.frame()
  colnames(survivor_team_df) = 'Survivor_Team'
  survivor_team_df = survivor_team_df %>% inner_join(games %>% select(team, opponent, Timeslot, game), join_by('Survivor_Team' == 'team'))
} else{
  survivor_team_df = NULL
}
    

```


```{r, results = 'asis'}

for (t in games %>% arrange(posix_timestamp_game) %>% select(Timeslot) %>% distinct() %>% pull())
{
  bets_this_timeslot = placed_bets %>% filter(Timeslot == t) %>% arrange(Team)
  
  if(!is.null(survivor_team_df) && nrow(survivor_team_df)> 0)
  {
    survivors_this_timeslot = survivor_team_df %>% filter(Timeslot == t)
  } else {
    survivors_this_timeslot = NULL
  }
  
  if((nrow(bets_this_timeslot) > 0) | (!is.null(survivors_this_timeslot) && nrow(survivors_this_timeslot) > 0)) #if there is at least one bet or survivor in this timeslot
  {
    print(tags$h1(t)) #main heading for the timeslot
    
    for(g in unique(games %>% filter(Timeslot == t) %>% pull(game)))
    {
      bets_this_game = bets_this_timeslot %>% filter(game == g)
      if(!is.null(survivors_this_timeslot))
      {
        survivors_this_game = survivors_this_timeslot %>% filter(Survivor_Team %in% games$team[games$game == g])
      } else {
        survivors_this_game = NULL
      }
      exist_survivors = !is.null(survivors_this_game) && nrow(survivors_this_game) > 0
      exist_bets = nrow(bets_this_game) > 0
      if (exist_survivors | exist_bets)
      {
        print(tags$h4(g))
        if(exist_survivors) #survivor section
        {
          for(s in 1:nrow(survivors_this_game))
          {
            print(tags$p(paste0('Survivor pick: ', survivors_this_game$Survivor_Team[s])))
          }
        }
        if (exist_bets)
        {
          players_this_game = bets_this_game %>% group_by(Label) %>% summarise(Bettors = paste(unique(Bettor), collapse = ","), TeamFullName = max(TeamFullName), Number = max(jersey_number), Position = max(position)) %>% arrange(TeamFullName)
          for(p in 1:nrow(players_this_game))
          {
            print(tags$p(paste0(ifelse(length(bettors) > 1, paste0(players_this_game$Bettors[p], ": "), ''), players_this_game$Label[p], ' (', players_this_game$TeamFullName[p],', ', players_this_game$Position[p], ' #', players_this_game$Number[p], ')'))) 
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}


```
